about: The ship's broadcast and how every voice aboard is recorded. The officers and leading hands are people, and each one's recorded voice is the `cast` in their own file (content/people/<id>.json); `speakers` here is only `ship`. Each speaker's cast is a voice designed with Gemini TTS from `design` (1-2 sentences: age, gender, timbre, accent; permanent traits only) and saved in the Google project; `voiceId` is that saved voice (`node tools/voices.mjs --design` makes any that are missing, in your own project if you cloned this). `style` is the short acting note sent with every line. tools/voices.mjs works out every fixed line the game can say (the career's orders, the watch pipes, the `ship` calls below) and records the ones not yet in assets/voice/. The game plays a clip when it has one for the exact line and falls back to the browser's own speech when it has not. `ship` is the main broadcast (the bridge, flight control, the damage control speakers); `tannoy` puts it through a speaker. `sample` is the line --sample renders to audition the voice. A crew drawn from all over Earth: cast to the 3D body each one is given (crew.mjs deals the people in turn).

ship.design: A clear, even-voiced woman in her thirties with a neutral Canadian accent, the trained cadence of a broadcast announcer.
ship.style: Urgent without panic; every word carries down a steel passage.
ship.sample: Action stations, action stations. Raider closing to starboard. Gun crews close up. Close all pressure doors.
